text:
Maya: quick heads-up, on the new ranked-6b-ptq run we see NDCG@10 drop ~3.5% on holdout compared to fp16 baseline. MRR@1 down ~1.2% :thinking_face:
Sam: can you paste the exact numbers and which holdout? small internal dev set or public gold set?
Maya: holdout: dev-2026-primaries (2k queries). fp16: NDCG@10 0.412, MRR@1 0.298. int8-ptq: NDCG@10 0.398, MRR@1 0.294. summary attached in the run log.
Ciara: did we use identical preprocessing/tokenizer between the eval harness and the prod scoring pipeline? last time a casing/tokenizer mismatch caused subtle changes.
Liam: flag: the eval harness was using tokenizers v2.1 (sentencepiece) while prod scoring uses our custom splice tokenizer v2.4. That can shift candidate truncation and priming tokens.
Maya: good call. EvalBot, which tokenizer was used for run 2026-04-17-78?
EvalBot: run 2026-04-17-78 metadata -> tokenizer: spm-v2.1, seed: 42, batch_size: 64, candidate_order: original. artifacts: s3://redwood-eval/runs/2026-04-17-78/metrics.json
Sam: also check candidate ordering. If the harness shuffled or deduped differently we'll get NDCG differences. Did we do dedupe?
Maya: harness config: 
```
{
  "dedupe_candidates": true,
  "candidate_pool_size": 100,
  "preserve_order": false
}
```
Sam: there it is — preserve_order false. Prod preserves canonical order. that could knock NDCG, esp for near-tie queries.
Ciara: plan: re-run the int8 eval with exact prod tokenizer and candidate-ordering flags. Liam can you spin the eval job and pin seed to 1234? also run fp16 with same preproc so it's apples-to-apples.
Liam: yep. launching job now. command I used: 
```
./eval_harness/run_eval.sh \
  --run-id rerank-reproc-1719234567 \
  --tokenizer /opt/tokenizers/splice-v2.4.model \
  --dedupe false \
  --preserve_order true \
  --seed 1234 \
  --model ranked-6b-ptq \
  --candidates 100
```
Maya: thanks. also add 200 golden queries (golden-anchors-200) so we can measure signal on known-critical cases.
EvalBot: job queued -> rerank-reproc-1719234567, expected runtime ~12m, run page: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/rerank-reproc-1719234567
InfraBot: FYI the model is on staging nodes gpu-pool-stg-3 (no traffic) :white_check_mark:
Sam: once re-run finishes, get NDCG/MRR diff per-slice: short queries (<5 tokens), long queries (>25), multilingual, and topk ties. post the small CSV.
Ciara: if numbers still diverge >2% after parity preproc, next step is to run xor-check: compare tokenized inputs between harness and prod for 100 random queries. I can own that.
Maya: assigning owners: Liam -> re-run and attach metrics, Ciara -> tokenizer parity check, Sam -> slice csv and quick triage. I'll coordinate follow-up and decide whether to revert ptq. :thumbsup:
Liam: will update thread with metrics CSV once done.
Maya: thanks, team. keeping it short so we can act fast. :rocket:
